images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a final, premium editorial pen-and-ink illustration for ATOMS, Budera's robotics and physical AI podcast. The input image is a CHARACTER DESIGN reference only: keep the two recognizable robot mascots, but invent an entirely new composition and poses. Character 1: tall elegant humanoid, rounded white helmet with a single dark featureless visor, white mechanical torso, exposed precision circular joints, long articulate limbs. Character 2: friendly short box-headed robot, two small rectangular eyes, vent details and a dark chest panel. Art direction: exceptionally crisp continuous navy-blue (#394e73) ink contours on pure white, subtle lighter blue-gray tonal washes and carefully controlled engraved crosshatching. Beautiful and sophisticated, like a collectible editorial science-magazine illustration. Confident line hierarchy, expressive body language, precise mechanical drawing, readable humor at 600 pixels wide. Detailed and high quality, not an overbusy technical blueprint, not a loose sketch, not a 3D render or photograph. No colored accents, gradients, tinted paper, grain overlay, lettering, labels, logos, watermarks or UI. Never add speech bubbles. Scene: a slightly eccentric but professional podcast studio. Both robots sit facing one another across a compact round recording table, with two clear professional broadcast microphones on articulated boom arms and a small audio interface with a few cables. The little box-headed host is perched on an absurdly tall, slightly wobbly stack of thick blank engineering books on its chair just to reach the microphone; it gestures with complete professional confidence. The tall humanoid sits in a comically undersized low armchair, long knees folded up awkwardly, calmly listening with a tiny espresso cup in one hand. Humor is warm and understated, apparent in the seating mismatch and confident poses. Keep the full robots, books, chairs and microphones visible. A single elegant floor lamp and one small acoustic panel suggest a studio, with the rest mostly pure white breathing space. Use a square composition, ideally 1536x1536, with the scene filling the central 85 percent and ample breathing room at every edge. Both robots should be large, engaging and clearly recording a podcast. Render a genuinely new scene; do not recreate the reference armchair arrangement.
